form_semantics.mapping_state_1: exact post-query mapping-class fiber cardinality equals one
form_semantics.family_state_1: exact post-query chart-family set cardinality equals one
form_semantics.operator_state_1: exact post-query operator set cardinality equals one
form_semantics.state_plus_zero: fiber remains non-singleton but at least one admissible future observation can deterministically reduce the relevant claim fiber
form_semantics.state_zero: non-singleton fiber cannot be reduced within the declared observational jurisdiction
